answer: Locks are logged in ledge, expire in wander, and knoll lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 56 aliases as a result needs 191 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3396 identities would post 4858 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
